governance.rationale: Reach and impact are low (primarily Josh + marketing, internal data, minor if down), which alone would be T1 — but the app creates records and calls external APIs (ingests DMARC reports, writes an audit log, calls ipinfo.io and public DNS), and the standard floors record-creating apps at T2. Not T3: no customer/compliance/operational data, nothing safety- or delivery-affecting.

access.rationale: One shared team dataset; every authorised user sees the same data. No in-app roles — Authentik group membership is the only gate.

egress.why: public DNS resolver for live DMARC/SPF/DKIM/BIMI record checks
read DMARC report emails/attachments from the mailbox (auto-ingest)
exchange the Gmail refresh token for an access token
